description: Validates a JSON document sent as the raw request body and returns it pretty-printed. Returns valid true/false, the formatted JSON, a count of keys, and byte size. Invalid JSON returns the parser error message. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/json-check.

body.description: POST / with raw JSON as the body

name: json-check
